CBH demonstrated exceptional financial strength in the most recent fiscal year, delivering record revenue and net profits alongside highly robust operating cash flows. Despite this impressive financial expansion and a growing equity base, the company has consistently maintained a zero-dividend payout policy over the past several consecutive years.

While macroeconomic shifts and capital deployment demands present general business uncertainties, CBH's strong profitability provides significant operational buffer. Because the company currently pays no dividend, there is zero risk of a dividend reduction for the upcoming financial year, maintaining a stable outlook regarding dividend safety.
